environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on EKS with Istio service mesh. Pod runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and uploads go to an emptyDir volume. AWS Secrets Manager agent sidecar injects SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET via shared memory volume, with automatic rotation configured at 60-second intervals via a custom Lambda rotation function (SecretRotationSchedule with AutomaticallyAfterDays: 0 and a CloudWatch Events rule triggering rotation every 60s). The Istio sidecar enforces mTLS with STRICT PeerAuthentication policy for the namespace, meaning only pods with valid SPIFFE identities issued by the mesh CA can reach this service. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sAllowedFileExtensions' is applied that uses a validating webhook to inspect multipart form uploads at the ingress gateway level, rejecting requests where the Content-Disposition filename parameter ends in executable extensions (.php, .jsp, .sh, .exe, .bat, .cmd, .ps1, .py, .rb, .pl, .cgi, .aspx, .war, .jar). The emptyDir volume is backed by memory (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 100Mi) and is not shared with any other workload.

config.secret_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager with 60s rotation via CloudWatch Events + custom Lambda rotator
config.pod_security: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, seccompProfile: RuntimeDefault
config.upload_storage: emptyDir with medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 100Mi, pod-local only
config.ingress_policy: OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate K8sAllowedFileExtensions validating webhook on ingress
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricting ingress to istio-ingressgateway pods only
config.downstream_processing: none - files consumed only by in-pod indexer process
